Who is Beedle's Assistant?

that I've never seen before! You're so lucky to meet me at this time! This shop will close in just , and I'm having a clearance sale.|Beedle's Assistant|TWW}} Each day, counts down the remaining days until closing day. This is revealed to be a marketing ploy the day after "closing day", when holds a "grand reopening" sale with the prices the same as before. He claims to have closed the shop for interior remodeling, but in reality makes only token changes to the shops's appearance.

In , runs the near . When gets the first upgrade to the , he becomes able to afford the , , and for sale at the . At that point receives a from advertising for the shop.

In , and his appear at random locations on the ocean from 10pm to midnight on weekdays, and 10am to noon on weekends (according to the Nintendo DS clock). He sells a single and a "Good Thing" (a ), as well as , and .
